method: full-text archive (agent/terms-archive, 2026-11-25): every paragraph of the archived terms, help and agreement pages matching the discretion, sanction, rule-change, separate-agreement, asymmetry and consistency lexicons reviewed by hand

facts.text: Prohibited Conduct includes 'any other type of behavior that the Company deems, in its sole and reasonable discretion, to be unlawful, unethical, deceptive, manipulative, high-risk, or otherwise posing an undue risk'; the Company has 'sole and absolute discretion in determining whether a violation has occurred', and corrective actions include 'withholding or forfeiture of funds, payouts, or rewards', without refund or compensation.
'Acting in a manner that may cause reputational or financial harm to the Company' is a violation that allows the same corrective actions, including withholding or forfeiture of payouts.
Flex plan: 50% consistency during the evaluation only; Pro funded accounts state no consistency rule.
